$comment: Tier 1 form detection parameters for the lat pulldown. DRAFT for Tony to edit. Every number is a PLACEHOLDER picked so the synthetic good rep passes and each synthetic fault fails; none is a clinical or literature value yet. Set min and/or max per check; leave both out to report the number without judging it. Feature definitions: src/pulldown/features.ts. `fault` values are Tier 1 error codes and match content/rules/tier2/lat_pulldown.yaml where that file has a code; incomplete_bottom_rom and fast_eccentric are not in it yet. lumbar_hyperextension and humeral_anterior_glide have no check: MediaPipe has no spine or scapula/humeral-head landmarks to separate them from trunk lean and shoulder movement. Once the Tier 1 rule schema exists (M6a) this moves to content/rules/tier1/.

checks.why: Elbows should be close to straight at the top so the lats reach a lengthened position.
Upper arm should be well overhead at the top (shoulder flexion/abduction near end range).
Wrists should come down to about shoulder level (bar at the upper chest), not stop at the chin.
Upper arms should finish close to the trunk (shoulder adduction/extension near end range).
A slight lean back is normal; a big lean turns it into a row.
Trunk angle should change little within a rep; large changes mean the torso is swinging the weight.
Fast trunk extension during the pull is the signature of using momentum.
Shoulders should move away from the ears (scapular depression) as the bar comes down.
The head should stay in line with the trunk instead of poking forward to meet the bar.
The bar should be lowered under control. Measured over 95%-5% of travel, so ~1.0 s here is ~1.4 s end to end.
Both hands should arrive together; a tilted bar means one side is doing less.
Left and right elbow angles should track each other.
Reported only. Add a min to require a stretch pause at the top.
